review_comments: this file has much of redundant formatting...
as I understood it can be a non-entity-schema entity
and here we'll have a check for type not being undefined.
why do we need these changes? Basically, we shouldn't change this file and only `EntitySchemaTransformer` should be changed.
as I wrote below, we need to make embeddedMetadata.type equal to Function | undefined then we can rewrite this code just a bit and avoid duplication.
Lets make it undefined if entity schema is used.
I think what we should do instead is to mark `type` as optional, and don't store anything here if type is entity schema is used.
